monitors.coordinate_space: GetMonitorInfo rects — process-view; GetDpiForMonitor is physical effective DPI for that monitor

cursor_pos.coordinate_space: GetCursorPos — process-view screen coords (DPI-virtualized when process is unaware)

physical_cursor_pos.coordinate_space: GetPhysicalCursorPos — physical screen coords (matches typical WH_MOUSE_LL pt when process is DPI-unaware)

msllhook_pt_coordinate_space: MSLLHOOKSTRUCT.pt — screen coordinates delivered to WH_MOUSE_LL; often physical/per-monitor space and may disagree with GetSystemMetrics under DPI virtualization.
raw_absolute_coordinate_space: RAWMOUSE absolute lLastX/lLastY are 0..65535 normalized over primary or virtual desktop; mapped with (size-1) into the chosen metrics space, then optionally aligned to hook space.

alignment.detail: metrics space already matches hook space
alignment.note: Scale is measured at runtime; never assume 2.0.

note: Do not change process DPI mode to 'fix' coordinates. Prefer explicit, logged conversion (LogicalToPhysical / measured scale). Never hardcode a 2x ratio.
